messages:
Alex (CSM): Quick check — ACME has a renewal in 6 weeks and health is yellow. Last NPS 6. Onboarding lags.
Priya (CS Ops): I saw usage drop ~40% over the last 30d. No recent training sessions.
Mateo (Solutions): They hit intermittent streaming errors after model upgrade. Ticket #5423 open and triaged.
Jen (AM): Renewal owner flagged risk and asked for a concrete save plan.
Alex (CSM): Draft save plan:
```
1) Immediate (72h): 1:1 troubleshooting session with eng + solutions to resolve blocking errors
2) Week 1: tailored enablement workshop for 6 power users (recording + materials)
3) Weeks 2-4: twice-weekly usage nudges + weekly health digest to exec sponsor
4) Week 4: NPS pulse and feature adoption check
5) If no recovery by Week 6: offer structured downgrade to Starter with 50% proration + 3 months of onboarding credits
```
Priya (CS Ops): Add measurable success criteria: DAU >= 30, avg latency <200ms, zero P0 errors for 7d.
Mateo (Solutions): I'll own the 1:1 and follow the hotfix rollout. ETA for fix candidate: 48h. :hammer_and_wrench: 
Jen (AM): Add a conditional uplift clause: if they commit to the workshop and metrics improve, we keep renewal at current tier but with a 3-month performance clause.
Alex (CSM): We'll capture feedback with a 5-question survey after the workshop. I'll draft.
Onboarder-bot: Reminder: schedule workshop -> calendar invite sent to acme-team@acme.com (auto-cc: Alex, Mateo)
Priya (CS Ops): I'll assemble enablement checklist + slide deck and share by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Alex (CSM): Can someone add the downgrade path to the renewals playbook page so AMs have copy/paste language? https://wiki.redwood/renewals/playbooks
Mateo (Solutions): Done — added technical rollback triggers and messaging snippets.
Jen (AM): Reconvene 48h after the 1:1. If ACME accepts downgrade, change renewal risk from High -> Medium.
Alex (CSM): I'll update the customer record (SFDC) and loop in Legal for proration wording.
Priya (CS Ops): Added an eval job to capture NPS delta and feature adoption after the workshop.
Alex (CSM): Thanks team — actionable and timeboxed. :thumbsup:
